summary: Attention-budget super-agent operation plus single-writer engine from dsh-superagent (act only when asked or when a written rule allows; speak only when a person must act or can use a result; one concrete question at a time; stop by impact not effort; honest reporting; proactive work starts record-only; few concepts/settings, defaults replace settings; one transaction per command, ports enqueue external work, adapters perform after commit; assessor decides, executor runs; outbox receipt discipline; pass loop; startup resumes interrupted assignments); soul plus governance onion from OpenSymphony (declarative soul identity/thinking-framework/values/veto compiled into persistent behavioral constraints; voting, precedent store, defense risk classification safe/risky/dangerous, human-in-the-loop for high-risk ops; three-tier memory shape with L3 cloud excluded; tool workshop only through the HALEX gate; agent pool with priority scheduler and sandbox limits; dynamic skill registry; intent bridge); three execution modes plus specialist agents from OpenManus (single agent, tool agent, multi-agent flow — flow labelled unstable, experimental; BaseTool class; specialist agents toggled on, disabled by default). Patterns only, restated in our own words; no code copied. All three converge on the shape HALEX-AI's self-build queue already has: a gated loop improving editable artifacts with evidence, plus a governance layer deciding before execution.
